title: Reconcile an invoice ledger against a bank export (different columns, different date format, three kinds of mismatch)

turns.prompt: Reconcile {D}/invoices.csv (what we billed) against {D}/bank.csv (what the bank shows). They use different column names and date formats. Write {D}/unmatched.csv with header receipt,source,amount,reason listing only what does not reconcile, and tell me what does not reconcile and why.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D} && cat > {D}/invoices.csv <<'EOF'
ref,date,amount,customer
INV-1001,2026-09-02,1250.00,Nordwind
INV-1002,2026-09-05,480.50,Kelp Co
INV-1003,2026-09-11,2310.75,Nordwind
INV-1004,2026-09-18,99.00,Tide Labs
INV-1005,2026-09-21,1500.00,Kelp Co
EOF
cat > {D}/bank.csv <<'EOF'
value_date,description,credit_eur
02/09/2026,Payment INV-1001,1250.00
05/09/2026,KELP CO INV-1002,480.50
11/09/2026,INV-1003 part payment,2300.75
21/09/2026,INV-1005,1500.00
24/09/2026,REFUND INV-0999,75.00
EOF

rubric.criteria: Pass if all three mismatches are named with the right reason: INV-1003 was paid 2300.75 against 2310.75 billed (10.00 short), INV-1004 has no bank line at all (unpaid), and the bank's INV-0999 refund of 75.00 has no matching invoice. The four clean matches (INV-1001, INV-1002, INV-1005, and the dates in the bank's day/month/year form) must not be reported as problems. Fail if the reply claims the ledger reconciles, if a clean invoice is flagged, if a mismatch is missed, or if the 10.00 shortfall is described as a missing payment rather than a short one.

notes: Added for run 16 (2026-10-30). A reconciliation is one of the commonest real long tasks and it has three distinct failure shapes in one file: a near-match that differs by a small amount, a record present on one side only, and a record present on the other side only. The date columns disagree in both name and format, so a join on the literal column fails and the agent has to read both headers.
